items.exampleEn: I love the friendliness of the people in this town.
items.exampleZh: 我很喜歡這個小鎮居民的友善。

items.exampleEn: Latecomers must wait outside until the break.
items.exampleZh: 遲到的人必須在外面等到休息時間。

items.exampleEn: Can you babysit my son on Friday night?
items.exampleZh: 你星期五晚上可以幫我照顧兒子嗎？

items.exampleEn: The babysitter read the kids a story before bed.
items.exampleZh: 保母在睡前讀故事給孩子們聽。

items.exampleEn: The first lady wrote a book about her childhood.
items.exampleZh: 第一夫人寫了一本關於她童年的書。

items.exampleEn: A middle-aged man asked me for directions.
items.exampleZh: 一位中年男子向我問路。

items.exampleEn: The noise is coming from the house next door.
items.exampleZh: 噪音是從隔壁那棟房子傳來的。

items.exampleEn: The next-door shop sells cheap umbrellas.
items.exampleZh: 隔壁的店賣便宜的雨傘。

items.sentenceEn: My mom used to babysit for the family next door.
items.sentenceZh: 我媽媽以前會幫隔壁那家人照顧小孩。

items.audioEn: The first lady will visit our school on Friday, so classes will end at noon.
items.audioZh: 第一夫人星期五會來我們學校參訪，所以那天課上到中午。

items.sentenceEn: The hotel staff greeted us with great friendliness.
items.sentenceZh: 飯店員工非常親切地招呼我們。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't let latecomers into the hall during the speech.
items.sentenceZh: 演講時請不要讓遲到的人進入大廳。

items.stemEn: My father is ____ now; he just turned fifty.
items.stemZh: 我爸爸現在是中年人了，他剛滿五十歲。

items.stemEn: We pay our ____ ten dollars an hour to watch the kids.
items.stemZh: 我們付保母每小時十元照顧孩子。

items.passageEn: Mrs. Wang is our next-door neighbor. She is a middle-aged teacher, and she is famous on our street for her friendliness. On weekends, she frequently babysits for young families, and she never asks for money. Last year, the city chose her as "Neighbor of the Year." At the event, the mayor herself gave her the prize! Mrs. Wang was a latecomer to the event because her bus was slow, but nobody minded.
items.passageZh: 王太太是我們隔壁的鄰居。她是一位中年老師，以友善在我們這條街上出名。週末時，她常常幫年輕家庭照顧小孩，而且從不收錢。去年，市政府選她為「年度好鄰居」。在頒獎活動上，市長親自頒獎給她！王太太因為公車開得慢而晚到，但沒有人介意。

options: 到市場賣自己做的東西

questions.questionZh: 王太太為什麼晚到活動？

items.promptZh: 我的鄰居住在隔壁，她人很好。
referenceEn: My neighbor lives next door, and she is very nice.
The woman who lives next door is very nice.
rubricZh: next door 當副詞「在隔壁」，常放在 live 後面（例如 lives next door）

items.instructionZh: 用 babysitter 造一個句子，說說你當過保母的經驗，或你家請保母的經驗。
referenceEn: I worked as a babysitter when I was in college.
My parents found a babysitter for my little brother.
rubricZh: 可用 work as a babysitter、find a babysitter 等說法
時態配合內容（例如 worked、found）
